CRSP return of the first trading day of month t (market calendar); missing if the stock has no return that day. Known at the end of month t on its own row. Read through the row of month t+1 it is observed AFTER the order of t is submitted: it only values the holding return from the close of that first day, (1 + ret_lead1) / (1 + ret_d1 of t+1) - 1. It must never change a rank, a budget or an order formed at t. It is not a cost or spread measure and not a predictor. A known value does not prove that a trade was possible that day

Built from the ratios of the CRSP factor (DlyCumFacShr) where its exported level is precise, from the dated share events (type FRS) otherwise; only past events enter. Missing when the daily file has no row that day (it starts in 1960). Only to be used as a ratio between two dates of the same stock, inside chcsho_* and div*_me: never rank it, never use its level or its missing flag
